questions.text: Identify and explain types of market failures in economies.
questions.expectedAnswer: Types: externalities, public goods, monopoly power, information asymmetry.
questions.markingGuide: Identify and explain main categories of market failures.

questions.text: Analyse negative externalities and market outcomes.
questions.expectedAnswer: Negative externalities lead to overproduction relative to social optimum.
questions.markingGuide: Show how externalities cause market failure with analysis.

questions.text: Evaluate government policies to address market failures.
questions.expectedAnswer: Evaluate policies: taxes, regulation, subsidies for effectiveness and trade-offs.
questions.markingGuide: Critical evaluation of policy options and their consequences.

questions.text: Comprehensive market failure and policy analysis.
questions.expectedAnswer: Integrate failure types, causes, and optimal policy responses.
questions.markingGuide: Sophisticated synthesis of failure analysis and policy design.
